verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a Git hosting and collaboration platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of an in-product AI assistant that can take delegated tasks. The official MCP server (gitea-mcp) and the tea CLI let external agents work with Gitea, but they are adjacent building blocks, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
